banisher.help: White creature that exiles a permanent until it leaves

marshal.help: White creature with an activated ability to pump the board

pridemate.help: White creature that grows over time

angel.help: White uncommon with large stats and flying

tokens.help: White spell that creatures two or more tokens

giantkiller.query: id=w (otag:removal otag:hate-high-pt or otag:hate-high-mv) (st:expansion r<r) sort:date

joust.help: White removal that damages an attacking or blocking creature

o-ring.help: White enchantment that exiles a permanent until it leaves

outnumber.help: White removal that deals damage based on board size

pacifism.help: White aura that prevents a creature from attacking or blocking

vengeance.help: White removal that targets a tapped creature or gets a cost reduction for one

disenchant.help: White removal for an artifact or enchantment

charge.help: White spell that pumps the board

flicker.help: Exile a creature, then return it to the battlefield

jumpscare.help: White combat trick that buffs a creature and gives it flying

reclamation.help: Return a low-cost creature from graveyard to battlefield

shield.help: White spell that protects a creature, usually with indestructible

shortsword.help: White equipment with a small buff

bigbird.help: Blue creature with flying for 4+ mana

bluedork.help: Blue creature that taps for mana

cancel.help: Blue counterspell, unconditional. Often has two blue pips.

scatter.help: Blue counterspell that can counter a creature spell, but not all spells

manaleak.help: Blue counterspell that asks for payment from the opponent

lockdown.help: Blue removal that keeps enchanted creature tapped

negate.help: Blue counterspell that can counter only some noncreature spells

tuck.query: otag:removal-tuck (-is:permanent or kw:channel) id=u (st:expansion r<r) sort:date
tuck.help: Blue removal that puts a creature on top (and/or bottom) of library

draw3.help: Blue spell that draws three cards

draw2.help: Blue spell that draws two cards

dig.query: otag:card-advantage (o:look or o:reveal) id=u -t:creature (st:expansion r<r) sort:date
dig.help: Blue spell that draws one card, with selection

wipeout.help: Blue spell that stuns or bounces two or more targets

rats.help: Black creature that makes the opponent discard

vamp.help: Black flyer with medium stats. Often has haste or deals direct damage

splinter.help: Black removal spell with an additional cost

edict.help: Black removal spell that forces sacrifice

plague.help: Black sweeper that gives a small -N/-N to all creatures

mindrot.help: Black spell that makes opponent discard two or more cards

thoughtseize.help: Black discard spell that lets you choose

fakedeath.help: Black spell that returns a creature to the battlefield when it dies

reanimate.help: Return creature from graveyard to battlefield

salvage.help: Black spell that returns two cards from graveyard to hand

signinblood.help: Black spell that draws two cards for an extra cost

pinger.help: Small red creature with an activated ability that deals 1 or 2 damage

ponger.help: Small red creature with a trigger that deals 1 or 2 damage

reddork.help: Blue creature that taps for mana

rummager.help: Red creature that can repeatedly discard to draw

tunneler.help: Red creature that makes a small creature unblockable

axe.help: Red burn spell that's expensive and deals high damage

pyroclasm.help: Red spell that deals small damage across the board

tweeze.help: Red spell that deals damage and also churns through cards

abrade.help: Red modal spell that deals damage or destroys an artifact

impulse.help: Red spell that exiles two or more cards from your library to cast soon

surestrike.help: Red spell that gives target creature first strike at instant speed

threaten.help: Red spell that gains control of a creature until end of turn

root.help: Red spell that discards one, draws two

trumpet.help: Red spell that pumps the board

brokenwings.help: Green modal removal for flyers, artifacts, enchantments, and/or graveyard

bite.help: Green removal that causes a one-sided fight

fight.help: Green removal that causes a fight

naturalize.help: Green removal for an artifact or enchantment

mulch.help: Green spell that draws one card with selection

ramp.help: Green spell that puts a land or equivalent onto the battlefield

multiramp.help: Green spell that puts two or more lands or equivalent onto the battlefield

regrowth.help: Green spell that returns a card from graveyard to hand

cryptkeeper.help: Artifact creature that removes cards from a graveyard

myr.help: Artifact creature that taps for mana

pilgrim.help: Artifact or colorless spell that tutors for a land

boombox.help: Artifact or colorless spell that can expensively remove a creature

fetchland.query: otag:tutor-land t:land id=c (st:expansion r<r is:booster) sort:date
fetchland.help: Land that sacrifices to tutor for another land

manarock.help: Noncreature artifact that taps for mana

cantripper.help: Creature whose main feature is replacing itself

recover.help: Creature that returns itself from graveyard to hand

brontodon.help: Creature that sacrifices to destroy an artifact or enchantment

swap.help: Spell that removes a creature but gives a resource to its controller

overrun.help: Spell that punmps the board and gives trample
